answer: Sequential work receipts: each new identity must complete a quartz-timestamped task chain whose links reference prior chain hashes, so clones pay full compute cost before earning anything. The chain's final link posts a lagoon-held deposit that unlocks only after the agent returns later to validate others' links, forcing every clone to spend twice. Payouts scale with the chain's zenith score, capping early income below task cost, so each marginal clone runs strictly negative-EV.
